Title: Virtual Network (VNET) support for HDInsight is now generally available

Body.Content:
Virtual Network (VNet) support for HDInsight is now generally available. In addition to HBase clusters, now you can provision Hadoop clusters in a VNet. HDInsight supports deploying only into a location-based VNet. Useful links to help you get started:
  • Setting up and configuring a VNet
  • Provisioning HDInsight cluster in a VNet
  • Connecting to HBase cluster provisioned in a virtual network using HBase Java RPC APIs
  • Moving data between on-premises SQL Server and HDInsight cluster using Sqoop
You can also review general HDInsight documentation.
